card.name: Filgrastim and G-CSF label text
card.fires_on: Marks in filgrastim or pegfilgrastim (G-CSF) label text, such as the G in G-CSF, the bracket before it, section numbers and small words before drug names. One stray spacecraft sentence also fires.

modes.label: Around G-CSF
modes.description: The G or opening bracket in the abbreviation G-CSF after granulocyte colony-stimulating factor.
